limitations: Input is SRTM-format test raster, not drone imagery. Zero-valued cells may encode ocean/background rather than measured zero-height land. Crops are from the same input, not independent submodels; EPSG:4326 grid, not metric drone-derived DEM; no accuracy, natural zero terrain, realistic seam, rights clearance, distributed or full ODM pipeline claim. No model/source/binary or dataset artifacts uploaded; exact private lock and packages discarded.
method: Read unmodified HGT values from a 256x256 crop; derive two overlapping, aligned subwindows from the same raster, adding nodata-only borders. Regenerate proximity maps, merge with installed ODM and compare every valid pixel with the original crop, including overlap-zero pixels.
